info.title: OMNIA service interoperability API
info.description: Optional service-neutral capabilities, not a central runtime. Services implement only the capabilities they expose. Authentication, authorization, TLS, discovery, retry and persistence policies are deployment responsibilities. This specification does not authorize public exposure.

get.summary: Read the responding service's health snapshot

200.description: Health snapshot; consumers must inspect status, not just HTTP success.

503.description: Service is not ready or unavailable; a health snapshot is still returned.

post.description: Acceptance is not completion or a guarantee of durable delivery. Receivers must validate eventType, eventVersion and payload before returning 202. Duplicate eventIds should not cause repeated side effects. No ordering, exactly-once delivery or broker is implied.

202.description: Event validated and accepted; empty response body.

get.summary: Read the Ice IQ event feed
get.description: Returns events in ascending feedPosition order. The first request uses after=0. A response contains at most 100 events; each serialized event is limited to 16 KiB and the serialized response to 2 MiB, measured in UTF-8 bytes. Never truncate or silently omit an oversized event. An empty feed returns 200 with events: [] and hasMore: false. hasMore=true means more events existed beyond the returned batch when the response was generated; false means no additional events existed at that moment. Events arriving afterward are picked up by the next poll. A future after cursor is invalid.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last acknowledged global feed position. Must not be negative, fractional, unsafe, or greater than the highest persisted position.

200.description: Feed page, including an empty events array and hasMore=false when the feed is empty.

400.description: Invalid after cursor or limit. No error response body is defined.

post.summary: Acknowledge the highest contiguous accepted feed position
post.description: Ice IQ validates that the acknowledgement is authenticated, monotonic, and no greater than its highest persisted feed position. Repeating the same value is harmless; a lower value cannot move the cursor backwards. MAGOS acknowledges only positions it has safely accepted contiguously. Acknowledgement never deletes outbox records. 204 No Content confirms the acknowledgement was accepted; it does not confirm that any outbox records were deleted.

204.description: Acknowledgement accepted. No response body. Acceptance does not mean any outbox records were deleted.

InvalidEvent.description: Invalid payload or unsupported event type/version; detail explains the validation failure without secrets.

Unavailable.description: Receiver cannot currently accept the event.
